about: Migdal Insurance and Financial Holdings Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides insurance, pension, and financial services for private and corporate customers in Israel. The company deals with and manages pension plans, life and health insurance products, pensions, and financial business plans; and provides personal accident and mortgage insurance solutions, and savings, as well as insurance agency services.
